### (d) Needs human eyeball

- The plan §12 assumption 11 marks the 24h threshold as MEDIUM confidence — the body flagged it as "the planner's call" between 24h / 72h / 7d. I chose the plan's default (24h). The threshold is env-overridable (`EPM_CODEX_OUTAGE_ALERT_HOURS`, clamp lo=1 hi=720), so a future operator can retune without a code change. Behavioral judgment: 24h is aggressive for a fresh outage but the compose-time live sentinel is already ~17d elapsed — ANY threshold ≤17d surfaces it immediately, so the value only matters for a future outage that starts within the alert-threshold window.
